propositions: The on-box MCP container cannot sign plan-review attestations because op-cert key resolution fails when REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH is unset, the genesis file is absent, and the ContextVar startup binding is not observed on the tool-call path.

The Ed25519 key file is already bind-mounted read-only at /run/secrets/opcert-ed25519-key on both launch paths (compose and blue-green docker run) but the environment variable pointing to it is missing from both.

Change 2328 attempted to set REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH as a fallback but was abandoned and proved ineffective because the deployed container uses the startup binding path which does not consult that variable.

The underlying root cause was fixed on dire-expectable-terrapin (change 2337) by aligning sign and verify to resolve the key from the same location, making the on-box MCP server capable of correct op-cert operations without REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH.
The ticket premise is now obsolete: the startup binding (composed from REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID + REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY) supersedes the env override path and is live-validated to work correctly.
